items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yes, I knew him in New York. Played with Clarence Williams.

ctx.x: I can see him. Is Valtuli? Valtuli the violin. Buddy Christian on the guitar. He was a piano player at the cabaret, you see? And he also played a little guitar.
Yes, I knew him in New York. Played with Clarence Williams. Frank Keeling on.
Huh? Yes, Frank Keeling. Yeah, that's a fine place.
